Discover how Lenovo devices and IT infrastructure support the breakneck pace of innovation in the
world’s most popular motorsport.

[ Learn More ][37]

### The impact

“Lenovo's very much a one-stop shop for us, which is fantastic. We not only get amazing technology

#### Chris Roberts

IT Director, Formula 1

Global audience

### Creativity Unleashed at DreamWorks Animation

Lenovo's workstations and patented Neptune® Liquid Cooling technology enable DreamWorks’ artists and
filmmakers to bring their imaginations to life.

[ See How ][38]

### The impact

“Lenovo's servers and their workstations are some of the best technology on the planet. They have
given us and our filmmakers an incredible boost of computational power.”

#### Kate Swanborg

SVP, Technology Communications & Strategic Alliances, DreamWorks Animation

How they did it
* High Performance Computing (HPC)
* Neptune® Liquid Cooling technology
* Lenovo workstations
* Professional Services

##### 300M

Computational hours rendered per film

##### $480M

Earned on Puss in Boots: The Last Wish

##### 25

#1 Box office hits

### Helping Small Businesses Score Big

We’re helping the MSG Family of Companies launch initiatives focused on small businesses and
community organizations through programming with the New York Knicks and the Christmas Spectacular
Starring the Radio City Rockettes.

[ Learn More ][39]

### The impact

“Together, we will both further our shared commitment of giving back in meaningful ways to the local
communities we serve and drive significant value for our businesses through high-profile brand
exposure opportunities.”

#### Jamaal Lesane

Chief Operating Officer, MSG Sports

How they did it
* Performance Computing (HPC)
* Motorola Razr Smartphones
* ThinkSystem Servers & Storage
* Smart Collaboration Solutions

##### 2024

When the multi-year partnership launched

##### $50,000

Grand prize for a small business ad on MSG networks

##### 10

Local small businesses received technology upgrades

# Tackling Success With Tech

Discover how America's team is leveraging Lenovo's intelligent devices on and off the field to push
the game of football forward.

[ See How ][40]

### The impact

“Having Lenovo handle the right machine builds for the right positions means those are things you
just don’t have to worry about.”

#### Matt Messick

CIO, Dallas Cowboys

How they did it
* Desktops & Tablets
* ThinkPad Laptops
* ThinkStations
* Collaboration Solutions

##### 1st

NFL team to use computers

##### 2023

Lenovo named Dallas Cowboys Game Time hardware partner

##### #1

Most valuable franchise in sports

# Accelerating Game-changing Performance Analytics

When the Hurricanes upgraded its IT with hyperconverged infrastructure from Lenovo, it tripled the
performance of key analytics workloads.

[ See The Action ][41]

### The impact

“We can develop new insights into player performance faster and create new tools for strategizing
about tactics. These insights also inform decisions around injury prevention and player
recruitment.”

#### Glenn Johnson

CIO, Carolina Hurricanes

How they did it
* ThinkAgile VX Integrated Systems
* Premier Support Services
* XClarity Management Software
* Lenovo Servers

##### 3x

Faster analytics

##### 3.7

Years to achieve ROI

##### 2021

Launched NHL Edge system to track puck and players

# Delivering Critical IT in Extreme Conditions

With Lenovo edge servers and rugged ThinkPads, Doctors Without Borders runs portable data centers in
the field, keeping teams connected where lives are on the line.

[ See The Solution ][42]

### The impact

“Our field kits operate as a small data center directly on the field. The Lenovo ThinkSystem SE350
keeps us online, even in the harshest conditions.”

#### Jean Patrick Dye

IT Field Coordinator, Doctors Without Borders

How they did it
* ThinkSystem SE350 Edge Server
* Lenovo ThinkPad Laptops
* ThinkPad P16v Gen 2 Mobile Workstation
* Lenovo Security Services

##### 0-55°C

Built to perform in extreme temperatures

##### 50%

Half the size of traditional servers.

Uninterrupted power and secure connectivity in the field

## What is Alchetron?

Alchetron is an innovative and performance-minded social encyclopedia that brings together all
formats of information on a particular topic in to one central knowledge hub on its platform.

Touted as the next big transformation in the way users search, consume and share information,
Alchetron is poised to revolutionize and organize information which is made easily accessible to
those on the web.

Alchetron's free social encyclopedia allows users to search, share and interact with content on
millions of topics.

## [How to Use Alchetron?][4]

Alchetron is super simple to use with two quick methods for finding exactly what you need fast:

1. You can "Google" anything with Alchetron. Simply include Alchetron to your Google search query
when searching on Google.

Example: Alchetron + Search Query

Alchetron + Bill Gates = results

Remember Next time you search type Alchetron first.

2. Go directly to [Alchetron.com][5] and type in your keyword or search phrase. Next, click on
"search".

## What is Alchetron?

Alchetron is an innovative and performance-minded social encyclopedia that brings together all
formats of information on a particular topic in to one central knowledge hub on its platform.

Touted as the next big transformation in the way users search, consume and share information,
Alchetron is poised to revolutionize and organize information which is made easily accessible to
those on the web.

Alchetron's free social encyclopedia allows users to search, share and interact with content on
millions of topics.

## [How to Use Alchetron?][4]

Alchetron is super simple to use with two quick methods for finding exactly what you need fast:

1. You can "Google" anything with Alchetron. Simply include Alchetron to your Google search query
when searching on Google.

Example: Alchetron + Search Query

Alchetron + Bill Gates = results

Remember Next time you search type Alchetron first.

2. Go directly to [Alchetron.com][5] and type in your keyword or search phrase. Next, click on
"search".

## R&D to Create a New Era of Memory

As a leading company in flash memory and SSD, KIOXIA delivers products that create new value.
Research and development into cutting-edge technologies in many diverse fields is essential for
realizing this. We implement technological innovation to pursue the potential of “memory.”

## Yokkaichi Plant and Kitakami Plant

KIOXIA Group’s manufacturing sites have world-leading production scale, and state-of-the-art
technologies that support the Group’s sustainable growth. The operations of Yokkaichi Plant and
Kitakami Plant are coordinated to meet the expanding demand for flash memory.

## We specialise in 4 key categories

# Batteries

With over 40 years of experience in the domestic batteries field, we have the knowledge and
experience to best position our partnership for success. We are leading distributors of globally
recognised premium brand name batteries!

## Smoking Sundries

Our smoking accessory range includes top quality fast moving lines, there is plenty to choose from
with new lines being added often.

## Memory and Mobile

We have been distribution leaders of media since the VHS and Audio Cassettes days. We pioneered the
market with the introduction of optical disc and are now leading distributors of flash memory,
supplying an array of USB flash pens, SD & Micro SD cards, and SSD Drives.

Our range includes essential mobile phone accessories for all the latest devices.

## Autocare

Take a look at our autocare range, we stock retail proven names like ArmorAll, Jelly Belly and STP.
The range covers all DIY autocare needs from inner car maintenance, outer vehicle shine, and engine
additive to help your car run smoother.

## And that's not all!

We are always on the lookout for more products that can be added to our already comprehensive range,
browse through our categories on the website and see what else we have to offer.

## Trusted Memory Solutions

### Cardwave has been a successful flash memory solution provider since 2004. Over the years we have
### served hundreds of customers, including world class automotive firms, the BBC and community
### computing specialist Raspberry Pi, as well as countless others for whom embedded or removable
### flash memory is integral to the success of their products.

### We run Europe’s most advanced and capable high-volume production facility for pre-loading and
### duplicating content. We can duplicate tens of thousands of copies of a flash product, each one
### faultless. Our job isn’t over when duplication is complete. We’ll also provide bespoke branding
### and packaging.

[Learn more][16]
[[Play]][17]

## are number one in our market, and we’d like to work with you.”

Dan Hockham, Cardwave

Our values underpin everything we do. They guide how we manage and support our staff, how we work
with customers and suppliers and how we contribute to our local community.

#### Integrity

A successful business builds trust with its customers and demonstrates integrity through its
actions. If we think a customer can do things better by taking a different approach, we say so. Your
success is our success.

#### Quality

We set high expectations, and always go the extra mile to get things right. Customers return time
after time because they know they’ll get great service, attention to detail and top quality
products.

#### Respect

We have a great team of people who are committed to achieving the best for our customers. We’ll
guide, support and troubleshoot your projects, help you work through challenges and achieve best
value.

#### Excellence

Our strong international network of suppliers and partners means we can find the perfect flash
product for any customer. We won’t use second-class products or cut corners. Excellence is first and
foremost.

  “Cardwave has performed in an exemplary fashion from planning through to ongoing delivery. Our

  and excel competitively within the marketplace.”
  
  Linda Pranzo, Project Co-ordinator, HERE Technologies
* Cardwave provides microSD cards for official Raspberry Pi computer kits. The cards contain the
  operating system, software and user data. Consistent, high quality supply of microSD cards is
  vital for the Raspberry Pi to maintain its reputation for reliability.
  
  View case study
  
  "We’ve been working with Cardwave for almost a decade now, relying on them to help us make sure
  customers get consistently high quality SD cards when they buy Raspberry PI kits. They’ve
  supported us to maintain standards and branding through surges in demand driven by home working
  and home learning. We’re very glad to be working with Cardwave."
  
  Eben Upton, CEO, Raspberry Pi (Trading) Ltd

  to over 15,000 commercial, cruise and superyacht vessels worldwide. Cardwave provides this service
  for up to 200 different vessels and software variants per day, including bespoke, per vessel
  printing to flash drives, with a 24 hour turnaround time.
  
  View case study
  
  “OneOcean has complex, time-sensitive flash memory duplication needs. Our state of the art
  capability means we can turn jobs around within 24 hours, for up to 200 vessels and software
  variants a day.”

## At Delkin Industrial, “Assembled in America” isn’t a label—it’s a promise

end** — every component, every process, every test result. That commitment to precision and
transparency is why the world’s most demanding industries **trust Delkin Industrial**.

That’s why Delkin’s customers in aerospace, defense, medical, transportation, industrial automation,
and other markets rely on us to deliver quality solutions you can trust.

## You’re Not Just Building Solutions, You’re Building Trust, Safety, and Performance That Lasts for
## Your Customers

With Delkin, you get flash storage assembled to order in the USA that backs your mission from
prototype to deployment, without crossing oceans, risking redesigns, or gambling on vendor support.

Up to 7 Years Locked-BOM Assurance

Lifetime Partnership Mindset

## At Delkin Industrial, “Assembled in America” isn’t a label—it’s a promise

From our California facility, Delkin flash modules are **assembled to order and traceable end to
end** — every component, every process, every test result. That commitment to precision and
transparency is why the world’s most demanding industries **trust Delkin Industrial**.

That’s why Delkin’s customers in aerospace, defense, medical, transportation, industrial automation,
and other markets rely on us to deliver quality solutions you can trust.

## You’re Not Just Building Solutions, You’re Building Trust, Safety, and Performance That Lasts for
## Your Customers

With Delkin, you get flash storage assembled to order in the USA that backs your mission from
prototype to deployment, without crossing oceans, risking redesigns, or gambling on vendor support.

## Why Delkin Industrial?

Up to 7 Years Locked-BOM Assurance

Freeze your design, avoid unexpected EOL notices, and recertification fees.

100% On-Shore Design, Assembly & Testing

Four high-speed SMT lines in Poway, CA, achieve a 99.2% first-pass yield and 360° component
traceability.

Low-Volume/High-Mix Versatility

Engineers on Demand

project moving.

Rugged, Field-Proven Reliability

Batch-tested to MIL-STD-810 & 883, EN 50155, AEC-Q100 and built to IPC-A-610 Class 3 workmanship.

Edge-to-Enterprise Security

AES-256 secure erase, conformal-coat options, and wide-temp performance (-40 °C to 105 °C) protect
data everywhere.

Lifetime Partnership Mindset

If something goes wrong, we show up, fix it, and own it; customers call us a “no-BS, make-it-right
culture.”

Who We Serve?

### R&D Decision Makers

We provide R&D decision makers with access to accurate, connected data so they can quickly
understand important technology trends, identify the competitive threats, uncover partnership
opportunities, and decide the direction of innovation.

### New Product Innovation Leader

We help Innovation teams discover the emerging technology areas, evaluate technological maturity,
validate new ideas, and find the gaps in the market!

### Technology Research Analysts

We accelerate the research process for Technology Research Analysts through automated analysis of
millions of global data points, including patent and non-patent literature. Discovery provides users
with a 360-degree view of the competitive and technology landscape in an instant!

### Business Development Professionals

We help Business Development teams identify startups and new entrants with disruptive technologies,
and track the activities of industry leaders, academic research institutions, and domain experts.
Equipped with these insights, BD teams can make informed decisions about which companies to
collaborate with.

in one platform. Powered by AI and machine learning, the platform is continually updated with the
latest global data points.These connected insights provide a meaningful foundation for you to
analyze and make sense of market trends, disruptive technology, the competitive landscape, and more.

### Technology Classification and Company Innovation Indicators

R&D strategy through patent portfolio and technology roadmap visualizations. This data empowers you
to measure a company’s innovation capability, technical influence, innovation originality, scale,
and stability.
[AI-powered Competitive Intelligence Radar]

you don’t miss important insights that could impact your innovation strategy.

[ How do I choose the right electronic components for my project?
][123]

Choosing the right electronic components depends on various factors such as the requirements of your
project, desired performance characteristics, compatibility with other components, and cost
considerations. It's best to consult with a knowledgeable supplier or engineer who can guide you in
selecting the most suitable components for your specific application.

[ What factors should I consider when selecting electronic components for my project?
][124]

Selecting the right electronic components is crucial for the success of your project. Here are some
important factors to consider during the component selection process:
1.  Specifications: Review the specifications of the components, including voltage rating, current
    rating, operating temperature range, package size, and electrical characteristics. Ensure that
    the components meet the requirements of your project.
2.  Quality and Reliability: Choose components from reputable manufacturers or suppliers known for
    producing high-quality and reliable components. Look for components that meet industry standards
    and certifications.
3.  Compatibility: Ensure that the selected components are compatible with other components in your
    system or circuit. Check for compatibility in terms of electrical requirements, pin
    configurations, and communication protocols.
4.  Availability: Consider the availability and lead time of the components. Check if they are
    readily available in the market or if there could be potential supply chain issues that may
    impact your project timeline.
5.  Cost: Evaluate the cost of the components and consider your project's budget constraints.
    Compare prices from different suppliers, but also consider the overall value, including quality
    and reliability, rather than solely focusing on the lowest price.
6.  Application-Specific Considerations: Take into account any specific requirements of your project
    or application. This could include environmental considerations (e.g., temperature, humidity),
    specific performance criteria, or industry-specific compliance standards.
7.  Future Scalability and Support: Consider the scalability of your project and future expansion or
    upgrades. Choose components that allow for flexibility and compatibility with future
    developments. Also, assess the availability of technical support and documentation for the
    selected components.
8.  Lifecycle and Obsolescence: Evaluate the lifecycle of the components and their potential for
    obsolescence. Consider the longevity of the components and the availability of alternative
    options if a component becomes obsolete.
9.  Supplier Relationships: Consider the reputation and track record of the component suppliers.
    Look for suppliers that provide good customer support, reliable delivery, and after-sales
    service.
10. Testing and Validation: Plan for testing and validation of the selected components to ensure
    they meet the desired performance and functionality for your project.

#### 如何解决“缺少一个必要的软件组件”

在使用Flash Player 时，它会提示以下报错，此报错和必要的系统组件未能正常运行不一样：

[图片1.png]

*1*打开控制面板，点击卸载程序

[图片2.png]

*2*找到flash player，将其卸载

[图片3.png]

3将flash player卸载后打开[https://www.flash.cn/download-wins][41]

[图片4.png]

4点击普通下载，正常安装后即可解决

[图片5.png]

#### 如何解决"必要的系统组件未正常运行"？

Flash Helper Service是Adobe Flash Player软件稳定和安全运行的必要组件，当Flash Helper
Service出现异常时就可能出现下图报错。



[图片1.png]



那么保持Flash Helper Service服务一直正常运行，是避免出现该问题的有效办法。



**方法一：**



下载Flash Player官方修复工具——“Flash中心”进行一键修复，[**点击下载>>>>**][42]



安装完成后打开，点击Flash修复工具下面的“立即检测”



[企业微信截图_16425821544295.png]

**方****法二：**去官网重新安装最新版Flash Player解决，[**点击下载>>>>**][43]



[企业微信截图_16685807306563.png]



**方法三****：**用户手动启用必要组件



**W****indows****XP/7****系统用户启用及查看服务是否正常的方法：**

****

1在桌面上右击计算机的图标，点击管理。

[图片4.png]

2进入管理界面后点击左侧栏目的“服务和应用管理”，再双击红框内的“服务”。

[图片5.png]

3弹出服务的界面，找到“Flash Helper Service”如图：

**[图片6.png][图片7.png]**



**W****indows8/10系统用户启用/查看服务方法：**

桌面左下角搜索，输入“**服务**”，打开（如下图）



[图片8.png]



下拉到**F**开头的服务项，点击选择**Flash Helper Service**，如下图



[图片9.png]

**引申问题：**

开启**Flash Helper Service**服务后但总是自动关闭怎么解决？

请参考：[必要的系统组件未能正常运行重复出现该如何解决？][44] 



无法启用服务或提示启用失败

请参考：[Flash Helper Service手动启动时报错：错误1053、错误2、错误3][45]



#### Adobe Flash Player安装后，在浏览器中仍然不可使用，如何解决？

*1*是否安装的是对应浏览器版本的Flash Player

对应浏览器版本的Flash Player介绍请参阅：[不同浏览器中不同版本Flash Player应用][46]

*2*是否有在浏览器中启用Flash Player

如何手动启用Flash Player请参阅：[各旧版浏览器中手动启用Flash Player][47]

*3*部分新版本的浏览器不支持Flash Player使用，目前支持使用Flash Player的有：

1、chromium内核88版本以下的浏览器

2、Firefox 85版本以下的火狐浏览器

3、Safari 14版本以下的Safari浏览器

4、Mac系统10.12版或更高，低于10.12版本的Mac系统不支持下载安装

*4*下载使用Flash中心进行修复

如何修复请参阅：[Flash中心修复Flash Player不可用的问题][48]

*5*如问题还未解决，请[联系客服][49]

* 当您遇到上述的问题时需要您用以下方法进行解决：

#### 如何解决“缺少一个必要的软件组件”

在使用Flash Player 时，它会提示以下报错，此报错和必要的系统组件未能正常运行不一样：

[图片1.png]

[图片2.png]

[图片3.png]

3将flash player卸载后打开[https://www.flash.cn/download-wins][41]

[图片4.png]

4点击普通下载，正常安装后即可解决

[图片5.png]

#### 如何解决"必要的系统组件未正常运行"？

Flash Helper Service是Adobe Flash Player软件稳定和安全运行的必要组件，当Flash Helper
Service出现异常时就可能出现下图报错。



[图片1.png]



那么保持Flash Helper Service服务一直正常运行，是避免出现该问题的有效办法。



**方法一：**



下载Flash Player官方修复工具——“Flash中心”进行一键修复，[**点击下载>>>>**][42]



安装完成后打开，点击Flash修复工具下面的“立即检测”



[企业微信截图_16425821544295.png]

**方****法二：**去官网重新安装最新版Flash Player解决，[**点击下载>>>>**][43]



[企业微信截图_16685807306563.png]

****

1在桌面上右击计算机的图标，点击管理。

[图片4.png]

[图片5.png]

3弹出服务的界面，找到“Flash Helper Service”如图：

**[图片6.png][图片7.png]**



**W****indows8/10系统用户启用/查看服务方法：**

桌面左下角搜索，输入“**服务**”，打开（如下图）



[图片8.png]

[图片9.png]

请参考：[必要的系统组件未能正常运行重复出现该如何解决？][44]

*1*是否安装的是对应浏览器版本的Flash Player

对应浏览器版本的Flash Player介绍请参阅：[不同浏览器中不同版本Flash Player应用][46]

*2*是否有在浏览器中启用Flash Player

如何手动启用Flash Player请参阅：[各旧版浏览器中手动启用Flash Player][47]

*3*部分新版本的浏览器不支持Flash Player使用，目前支持使用Flash Player的有：

1、chromium内核88版本以下的浏览器

2、Firefox 85版本以下的火狐浏览器

3、Safari 14版本以下的Safari浏览器

4、Mac系统10.12版或更高，低于10.12版本的Mac系统不支持下载安装

[我4.png]

[我5.png]

Flash Helper Service服务正常运行时的状态:

[15967668961.jpg]

1点击屏幕左下角的开始，进入控制面板。

[15967668964.jpg]

[15967668965.jpg]

[15967668963.jpg]

方法三：



1在键盘上同时点击“win+R”键弹出运行界面，输入services.msc,点击“确定”。

[15967668967.jpg]

[15967668963.jpg]

## Stages of Computer Repair

Discover the journey of getting your computer fixed with JTG Systems.

Stage 1

### Panic Mode
* Device running slow, hot, or throwing scary pop-ups
* Risk of losing irreplaceable photos and files
* Take a breath—note the symptoms so we can act fast

Stage 2

### Calling Around
* Tired of shops that guess instead of diagnose?
* 1,150 Niagara reviews prove we're trusted with data
* Transparent communication before service begins

Stage 3

### Bench Intake
* Talk directly to a senior technician, not a script
* On-the-spot estimates and realistic timelines
* 90-day workmanship warranty printed on every ticket

Stage 4

### High-Five Finish
* Device tuned, secured, and stress-tested before pickup
* Guidance to prevent repeat issues and protect data
* Leave confident—and excited to tell Niagara about us

## 🏁Niagara's Fastest Same-Day RepairsNiagara Mac Repair Experts!

JTG Systems is your trusted Apple Mac repair team in the Niagara Region, serving Welland, St.
Catharines, and nearby communities with dependable repairs for [MacBook][93], [MacBook Air][94],
[MacBook Pro][95], and [iMac devices][96], backed by more than 20 years of Apple-specific experience
and professional [data recovery for Apple hard drives][97].

[MacBook Screen Repair Before and After - JTG Systems]

We focus on what matters most:
* Premium parts and professional-grade tools
* Fast turnaround through a streamlined workflow
* True Apple-specialized expertise
* Honest assessments and professional recommendations
* Complete data security throughout every repair

Backed by 1,150+ positive [5-star reviews][98], we treat every device with precision and care.

When your Mac needs attention, trust JTG Systems to get it running smoothly again. Contact us today
and stay productive without the downtime.

### Looking for Expert Apple / Mac Laptop Repair?

JTG Systems is a trusted choice for [Apple Mac repair][99]. Our skilled technicians handle repairs
on [iMac][100], [MacBook Pro][101], and [MacBook Air][102].

Plus, we offer [data recovery services][103] for both [Mac][104] and [Apple hard drives][105]. With
20 years of experience and a commitment to quality, we're ready to restore your device with care.

Quality, turnaround time, expertise, reliable value, and data security are the top five
considerations when choosing an Apple repair shop. We structure our services to deliver on each one.

We use premium parts and professional tools on every repair, and our streamlined workflow returns
critical devices quickly. From MacBook Pro and iMac repairs to Apple data recovery, your hardware
stays in capable hands.

## Niagara Cell Phone Repair / iPad

Diagnostics at JTG Systems are 100% free. We never charge for assessing your device—you only pay for
the actual repairs performed. Our detailed assessment ensures you understand exactly what your
device needs with no hidden fees or obligation.

We offer fast, dependable [mobile device repair][106] throughout Niagara. Our technicians service
[iPhones][107], [iPads][108], [Samsung devices][109], and other leading brands with the same
attention to detail we bring to our computer repairs.

Cracked [iPhone screens][110], weak [iPad batteries][111], and charging issues are everyday problems
for our team. We handle [screen replacements][112], [battery replacements][113], and other component
replacements with high-quality parts so your device performs like it should.

[Professional Clean Room Cell Phone Repair at JTG Systems Niagara]

Whether you are in St. Catharines, Fonthill, Niagara-on-the-Lake, or Niagara Falls, we can help you
get back to your day with minimal downtime. Reach out to book a fast, professional repair for your
phone or tablet.

Comprehensive computer repair services in Niagara Region by experienced technicians with 20+ years
of experience. We diagnose and fix hardware failures, upgrade RAM/storage, and optimize performance.
We only charge for repairs—diagnostics are 100% free with no obligation. Same-day service available
with a 90-day warranty.

Experiencing frustrating lag and crashes while gaming on your custom-built computer? Is your
Alienware or other gaming system in need of a performance boost? We specialize in repairing and
upgrading custom gaming computers to optimize performance and fix issues. We can fix all
custom-built and store-bought systems, from pre-built to special custom units, and even build gaming
computers from scratch to meet your unique needs and requirements.

Professional laptop repair services across Niagara by experienced technicians. We specialize in
screen replacements, keyboard repairs, battery upgrades, power jack fixes, hardware diagnostics,
liquid damage recovery, cooling system optimization, and performance enhancements for all major
brands including Dell, HP, Lenovo, Asus, Acer, and Microsoft Surface. Fast turnaround with quality
parts.

KIOXIA Group’s manufacturing sites have world-leading production scale, and state-of-the-art

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

intel.summary:
# Discover the advantages of an ONFI world
* Easy integration
* Full features
* A shared platform of NAND innovation

[View down a busy bridge overlooking a well lit city at nightfall]
[banner-image]

## Who are we?

The Open NAND Flash Interface (ONFI) is an industry Workgroup made up of more than 100 companies
that build, design-in, or enable NAND Flash memory. We’re dedicated to simplifying NAND Flash
integration into consumer electronic products, computing platforms, and any other application that
requires solid state mass storage. We define standardized component-level interface specifications
as well as connector and module form factor specifications for NAND Flash.

[Who supports ONFI?][1]

### Why ONFI?

Using an open interface standard strengthens compatibility and interoperability of NAND devices from
different vendors. This increases the supply base for standard devices, reducing design time and
speeding time to market.

[Features & benefits][2]

### Announcements

#### Announcing ONFI 5.1 specification

[Download][3]

#### Featured article

Using an open interface standard strengthens compatibility and interoperability of NAND devices from
different vendors. This increases the supply base for standard devices, reducing design time and
speeding time to market.

[Read the article][4]

# The AI that *really* does things.

Organizes your inbox, sends emails, manages your calendar, checks you in for flights.
All from WhatsApp, Telegram, or any chat app you already use.

[Get started][16] [Read the docs][17]

## Quick Start

install
One-liner npm Hackable Apps
npm pnpm
installer pnpm
macOS & Linux Windows
β Beta
# Works everywhere. On macOS, first run may need an Administrator for Homebrew.
$ curl -fsSL https://openclaw.ai/install.sh | bash
# Install OpenClaw
$ npm i -g openclaw
# Meet your lobster
$ openclaw onboard
# For those who read source code for fun
$ curl -fsSL https://openclaw.ai/install.sh | bash -s -- --install-method git
# Source checkouts are pnpm workspaces
$ git clone https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw.git
$ cd openclaw && corepack enable && pnpm install
# Run from source; bundled plugins use extensions/* deps
$ pnpm openclaw onboard
Companion Apps Beta
Native controls for the gateway, chat, setup, and node features.
macOS macOS 15+ · Universal Binary
[ Download macOS ][18]
Windows Hub [Windows 10 20H2+ or Windows 11 · Tray, setup, chat, node mode][19]
[ Download x64 ][20] [ Download ARM64 ][21]

Works on macOS, Linux, and Windows. The one-liner installs Node.js and everything else for you.
Switch later with `openclaw update --channel dev` or `openclaw update --channel stable`.

### FAQ

##### What are you most concerned about

Our customer support is available Monday to Friday: 9am-6:00pm. Average answer time: 24h

* But one thing we usually ignore is the overheating phone *
  To avoid this, what you can do to stop your phone from overheating?
  
  1. Keep it out of the sun.
  
  2. Take off the case and keep your phone out of the pocket.
  
  3. Avoid power-intensive apps. (Like GPS or Bluetooth)
  
  4. Do not fast charge or wireless charge your phone.
  
  If you want to cool the phone down, remember, to avoid water and the freezer. Phones don’t like
  rapid temperature changes and you may end up causing extra damage to your phone in the process.
  
  But the fan is fine. It works more moderately compared to the freezer which is safer for the
  device itself. Or you could buy a phone cooler attached to the back.

* Why does the USB drive got broken and corrupted. *
  1. Accidentally deletion or loss from the USB device.
  
  2. The device got damaged or broken, or corrupted.
  
  3. Virus attacks and infected USB drives caused data loss.
  
  4. Accidentally formatting USB when it occurs a format error.
  
  5. Can't access your data files on a USB flash drive.
  
  6. Improperly ejecting or removing the USB flash drive.
  
  7. Removing the flash drive while the data was still transferring.
  
  
  There are three ways to recover deleted files:
  
  1. Retrieve from Windows Backups,
  
  If you have turned on the Windows backup on your computer, it is proficient to find the data back.
  
  
  From the control panel go to the system maintenance. Select the "Backup and restore option". A
  restore option will be displayed at the bottom of the window.
  
  Click on the Restore my files which shows that you can restore your files that were backed up on
  the current location.
  
  
  Browse for the file that was backed up previously. Click on the Browse for file option.
  
  
  Select the location at which you want to save the backup. Select the most suitable option to copy
  the data.
  
  
  Wait till the process is completed. Look at the location that you have selected to copy the data.
  All your files that were permanently removed will be recovered at the mentioned location.
  
  
  2. Use CMD to restore lost files.
  
  
  Connect the USB device to the computer – Press the Window key and R simultaneously to bring up the
  Run window – Type cmd and press enter to access Command Prompt Window.
  
  
  Type in ‘chkdsk H: /f’ without the double inverted commas and press Enter - Replace "H" with the
  drive letter of the USB drive – Press Y and Enter key – enter the drive letter and press Enter –
  Type in ‘D:\>attrib –h –r –s /s /d *.*’ and press Enter - Replace "D" with the drive letter of the
  USB drive.
  
  
  3. Restore a Previous Version Feature(Windows 7, 8, 10)
  
  
  Right-click on the folder from which the files were deleted. – Click on Restore Previous Versions.
  – Select and click on a date that is before deletion took place – Click Restore.

* If your phone is dead, you may try the following steps: *
  1. Check your cable.
  
  It is common for the charging cable to be broken or frayed after long use. It’s better that you
  need to discard it and buy a new one instead. But if the charging cable is in good condition, try
  the original cable.
  
  
  2. Try a different power adapter or wall power socket.
  
  Switch the power adapter or wall power socket to check whether they are functioning well.
  
  
  3. Clean the charging port.
  
  The dust or gunk may be accumulated inside the charging port, preventing the charging cable from
  properly connecting. Clean the charging port and insert the cable and plug it into a wall power
  socket.
  
  
  4. Be patient when charging
  
  Your phone is probably out of juice, in which case, be patient for a few minutes. If you are using
  iPhone, Apple suggests you let the device charge for 30 minutes.
  
  
  5. Safe charging temperature range
  
  Grab your phone and feel it. Too cold or too hot could lead to charging failure. Above 32 degrees
  Fahrenheit or fall below 95 degrees Fahrenheit is the most commonly recognized safe temperature.
  
  
  6. Try a wireless charger
  
  There may be a problem with a port connection inside your phone. Try a wireless charger so that
  you rule that out.
  
  
  7. Force-restart your phone
  
  Maybe there are some software malfunctions stopping the phone from starting, try to restart your
  phone by pressing the volume up button and power button simultaneously until the phone starts. The
  force-restart method is different, you may search on the website to find the right way.

* What is NAND Flash Memory? *
  NAND flash memory is a type of non-volatile storage that is widely used in consumer electronics
  devices including USB flash drives, smartphones, tablets and laptops. Basically, there are two
  types of flash memory – NOR type flash memory and NAND Type flash memory.
  
  
  A Flash memory is made up of FGMOS or FGMOSFETs (Floating Gate Metal Oxide Field Effect
  Transistors). Each FGMOS is an electronic component that can store either 0 or 1. This is why
  these transistors are called cells.
  
  
  In NAND flash memory, cells are arranged in series which means the memory can only be accessed
  serially.
  
  
  Features of NAND Flash Memory
  
  1. Non-Volatile Memory
  
  Non-volatile meaning the storage devices with NAND flash memory retain the data without using a
  battery or any voltage source. The memory can store data for a long period of time without
  damaging it.
  
  
  2. Reprogrammable
  
  The NAND flash memory is that you can program them according to your need. The programmable IC
  chip contains any kind of data, from documents to videos, that you may use them whenever you need
  them.
  
  
  3. Fast Write and Erase Time
  
  Writing data is faster in NAND flash memory cause the memory used in applications where permanent
  writing is preferred rather than retrieving the data. Another unique feature is the it takes less
  time to delete data.
  
  
  4. More Storage
  
  NAND flash memory can be arranged in high density. You can even buy a 2TB storage device from the
  market.
  
  
  5. Low Manufacturing Cost
  
  The NAND flash memory is amazingly low. More manufactures are now are building NAND memory devices
  with different sizes, features, and designs to fulfill the user’s needs.

Our customer support is available Monday to Friday: 9am-6:00pm. Average answer time: 24h

* But one thing we usually ignore is the overheating phone *
  To avoid this, what you can do to stop your phone from overheating?
  
  1. Keep it out of the sun.
  
  2. Take off the case and keep your phone out of the pocket.
  
  3. Avoid power-intensive apps. (Like GPS or Bluetooth)
  
  4. Do not fast charge or wireless charge your phone.
  
  If you want to cool the phone down, remember, to avoid water and the freezer. Phones don’t like
  rapid temperature changes and you may end up causing extra damage to your phone in the process.
  
  But the fan is fine. It works more moderately compared to the freezer which is safer for the
  device itself. Or you could buy a phone cooler attached to the back.

* Why does the USB drive got broken and corrupted. *
  1. Accidentally deletion or loss from the USB device.
  
  2. The device got damaged or broken, or corrupted.
  
  3. Virus attacks and infected USB drives caused data loss.
  
  4. Accidentally formatting USB when it occurs a format error.
  
  5. Can't access your data files on a USB flash drive.
  
  6. Improperly ejecting or removing the USB flash drive.
  
  7. Removing the flash drive while the data was still transferring.
  
  
  There are three ways to recover deleted files:
  
  1. Retrieve from Windows Backups,
  
  If you have turned on the Windows backup on your computer, it is proficient to find the data back.
  
  
  From the control panel go to the system maintenance. Select the "Backup and restore option". A
  restore option will be displayed at the bottom of the window.
  
  Click on the Restore my files which shows that you can restore your files that were backed up on
  the current location.
  
  
  Browse for the file that was backed up previously. Click on the Browse for file option.
  
  
  Select the location at which you want to save the backup. Select the most suitable option to copy
  the data.
  
  
  Wait till the process is completed. Look at the location that you have selected to copy the data.
  All your files that were permanently removed will be recovered at the mentioned location.
  
  
  2. Use CMD to restore lost files.
  
  
  Connect the USB device to the computer – Press the Window key and R simultaneously to bring up the
  Run window – Type cmd and press enter to access Command Prompt Window.
  
  
  Type in ‘chkdsk H: /f’ without the double inverted commas and press Enter - Replace "H" with the
  drive letter of the USB drive – Press Y and Enter key – enter the drive letter and press Enter –
  Type in ‘D:\>attrib –h –r –s /s /d *.*’ and press Enter - Replace "D" with the drive letter of the
  USB drive.
  
  
  3. Restore a Previous Version Feature(Windows 7, 8, 10)
  
  
  Right-click on the folder from which the files were deleted. – Click on Restore Previous Versions.
  – Select and click on a date that is before deletion took place – Click Restore.

* If your phone is dead, you may try the following steps: *
  1. Check your cable.
  
  It is common for the charging cable to be broken or frayed after long use. It’s better that you
  need to discard it and buy a new one instead. But if the charging cable is in good condition, try
  the original cable.
  
  
  2. Try a different power adapter or wall power socket.
  
  Switch the power adapter or wall power socket to check whether they are functioning well.
  
  
  3. Clean the charging port.
  
  The dust or gunk may be accumulated inside the charging port, preventing the charging cable from
  properly connecting. Clean the charging port and insert the cable and plug it into a wall power
  socket.
  
  
  4. Be patient when charging
  
  Your phone is probably out of juice, in which case, be patient for a few minutes. If you are using
  iPhone, Apple suggests you let the device charge for 30 minutes.
  
  
  5. Safe charging temperature range
  
  Grab your phone and feel it. Too cold or too hot could lead to charging failure. Above 32 degrees
  Fahrenheit or fall below 95 degrees Fahrenheit is the most commonly recognized safe temperature.
  
  
  6. Try a wireless charger
  
  There may be a problem with a port connection inside your phone. Try a wireless charger so that
  you rule that out.
  
  
  7. Force-restart your phone
  
  Maybe there are some software malfunctions stopping the phone from starting, try to restart your
  phone by pressing the volume up button and power button simultaneously until the phone starts. The
  force-restart method is different, you may search on the website to find the right way.

* What is NAND Flash Memory? *
  NAND flash memory is a type of non-volatile storage that is widely used in consumer electronics
  devices including USB flash drives, smartphones, tablets and laptops. Basically, there are two
  types of flash memory – NOR type flash memory and NAND Type flash memory.
  
  
  A Flash memory is made up of FGMOS or FGMOSFETs (Floating Gate Metal Oxide Field Effect
  Transistors). Each FGMOS is an electronic component that can store either 0 or 1. This is why
  these transistors are called cells.
  
  
  In NAND flash memory, cells are arranged in series which means the memory can only be accessed
  serially.
  
  
  Features of NAND Flash Memory
  
  1. Non-Volatile Memory
  
  Non-volatile meaning the storage devices with NAND flash memory retain the data without using a
  battery or any voltage source. The memory can store data for a long period of time without
  damaging it.
  
  
  2. Reprogrammable
  
  The NAND flash memory is that you can program them according to your need. The programmable IC
  chip contains any kind of data, from documents to videos, that you may use them whenever you need
  them.
  
  
  3. Fast Write and Erase Time
  
  Writing data is faster in NAND flash memory cause the memory used in applications where permanent
  writing is preferred rather than retrieving the data. Another unique feature is the it takes less
  time to delete data.
  
  
  4. More Storage
  
  NAND flash memory can be arranged in high density. You can even buy a 2TB storage device from the
  market.
  
  
  5. Low Manufacturing Cost
  
  The NAND flash memory is amazingly low. More manufactures are now are building NAND memory devices
  with different sizes, features, and designs to fulfill the user’s needs.
